walkthrough:
Differentiate $y = (5x - 1)^{\frac{1}{2}}$ with respect to $x$ using the chain rule:
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}(5x - 1)^{-\frac{1}{2}}(5) = \frac{5}{2\sqrt{5x - 1}}$$

Find the gradient of the normal line:
$$m_N = -\frac{1}{5/6} = -\frac{6}{5}$$

Write the equation of the normal at $P(2, 3)$:
$$y - 3 = -\frac{6}{5}(x - 2) \implies 5(y - 3) = -6(x - 2) \implies 5y - 15 = -6x + 12$$
$$5y + 6x = 27 \quad \left(\text{or } y = -\frac{6}{5}x + \frac{27}{5}\right)$$

ai_rubric.Normal Equation: Differentiates to $\frac{5}{2\sqrt{5x-1}}$ (B2). Finds normal gradient $-6/5$ (M1). States $5y + 6x = 27$ (A1).

skill_tags: Finding an Area Between a Line and a Curve

walkthrough:
Find the $x$-intercept of the curve $y = \sqrt{5x - 1}$ where $y = 0$:
$$\sqrt{5x - 1} = 0 \implies 5x - 1 = 0 \implies x = \frac{1}{5} = 0.2$$

Integrate under the curve from $x = \frac{1}{5}$ to $x = 2$:
$$\text{Area}_{\text{curve}} = \int_{1/5}^2 (5x - 1)^{\frac{1}{2}}\,dx = \left[ \frac{(5x - 1)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2} \times 5} \right]_{1/5}^2 = \frac{2}{15}\left[ (5(2) - 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} - 0 \right] = \frac{2}{15}(27) = \frac{18}{5} = 3.6$$

Find the $x$-intercept $Q$ of the normal line $5y + 6x = 27$ by setting $y = 0$:
$$6x = 27 \implies x_Q = \frac{27}{6} = \frac{9}{2} = 4.5$$

Calculate the area of the right-angled triangle under the normal line from $x = 2$ to $x = 4.5$ (base $4.5 - 2 = 2.5$, height $y_P = 3$):
$$\text{Area}_{\triangle} = \frac{1}{2} \times (4.5 - 2) \times 3 = \frac{1}{2}(2.5)(3) = 3.75 = \frac{15}{4}$$

Sum the two region areas to find the total shaded area:
$$\text{Total Shaded Area} = \text{Area}_{\text{curve}} + \text{Area}_{\triangle} = \frac{18}{5} + \frac{15}{4} = \frac{72 + 75}{20} = \frac{147}{20} = 7.35\text{ square units}$$

ai_rubric.Total Shaded Area: Integrates curve from $1/5$ to $2$ to obtain $18/5$ (B2, M1, A1). Finds normal intercept $Q(4.5, 0)$ and triangle area $15/4$ (M1, A1). Obtains total area $\frac{147}{20} = 7.35$ (A1).
